policy: Selected primary-source literature review. No local GPU benchmark was run. Published measurements, vendor claims, simulated results, and unmeasured engineering inferences remain distinct. Results cannot be compared across studies as if they shared conditions.

sources.title: MiniMax-M2.5 FP8 on RTX PRO 6000, corrected practitioner report
sources.locator: Opening post and February 20 follow-up; Results table; What Happened to the +16.8%?
sources.review_caveat: self-reported; configuration-specific; no matched other-GPU control

sources.title: Artifacts linked by G7e benchmark author
sources.review_caveat: Artifact URL verified from original report; artifacts not independently rerun

sources.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra Sets New Inference Records in MLPerf Debut

sources.locator: Hopper continues to improve; Figures 1–2 footnotes

sources.title: MLPerf Inference v5.1 submissions
sources.review_caveat: Repository artifacts were inspected, not executed

sources.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision, v2

sources.title: PyTorch FSDP: Experiences on Scaling Fully Sharded Data Parallel, v1

sources.review_caveat: NVIDIA/Microsoft/academic authors; weak scaling; full-training duration projected

sources.title: SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models
sources.review_caveat: Academic/industry authors; W8A8 recipe and historical models, not FP4 blanket quality

sources.title: Demystifying NCCL: An In-depth Analysis of GPU Communication Protocols and Algorithms, v1
sources.locator: Section V-E; Figure 6; source version statement

sources.title: ServerlessLLM: Low-Latency Serverless Inference for Large Language Models
sources.review_caveat: Cold checkpoint loading metric; not a token-generation or isolated NUMA benchmark

sources.title: Accelerate Generative AI Inference on Amazon SageMaker AI with G7e Instances
sources.review_caveat: Unresolved four-versus-two-GPU description for G6e baseline; historical SageMaker pricing; not EC2 pricing

sources.title: Scaling MoE reinforcement learning on Amazon EKS with EFA and DeepEP with 40% more throughput
sources.review_caveat: EFA/DeepEP enabled deployment; not EFA-versus-TCP or G7e portability isolation
